The DECO BLUE SR HPR is a decorative and privacy-enhancing blue window film that not only amplifies the aesthetic appeal of your space but also delivers exceptional performance. The DECO BLUE SR HPR offers a balanced blend of solar energy and visible light control. With a solar energy transmission of 61% for single glazing and 53% for double glazing, it ensures a cooler interior space by rejecting a significant portion of solar heat. Its visible light transmission stands at 29% for single glazing and 27% for double glazing, making it ideal for privacy without sacrificing too much natural light. UV Protection and Energy Efficiency

In terms of UV protection, the film excels by transmitting less than 1% of Ultraviolent rays and providing over 99% rejection, prolonging the lifespan of your interiors and protecting occupants from harmful radiation. Additionally, its shading coefficient and total solar energy rejected figures (0.79, 31% for single; 0.83, 28% for double) highlight its efficiency in managing energy.

Physical Properties

The DECO BLUE SR HPR also features robust physical properties, including a U value of 6 W/m².K for single glazing and 2.74 W/m².K for double glazing, and an emissivity of 0.9. Its color rendering index of 32 ensures that colors viewed through the film appear natural and vibrant.

Warranty and Installation
